scope: Independent literal-author preparation only; no encoder or producer implementation, import or execution.

finite_batch.question: Freeze exact descriptor record_size and count for each of the eight sections, including the fragment query section with a 0, 8, 36, 592 or 8202 byte frame. Its variable frame length cannot be inferred from the original-profile 8218-byte per-file layout.
finite_batch.golden_effect: Every section descriptor has independent literal bytes and size arithmetic.

finite_batch.question: Freeze the value representation of an absent fragment expected_size separately from known zero. Restrict or encode input_handle_atom tags explicitly: a single present bit plus zero bits cannot distinguish input NULL from HANDLE0.
finite_batch.golden_effect: The value-to-bytes mapping remains unambiguous without falsey-value normalization.

finite_batch.question: The live canonical error-definition slot has UNOBSERVED, False and True states. Freeze their mapping through ERROR_DEFINITION_OBSERVED and ERROR_DEFINED, including whether True on a successful scalar branch is invalid. Do not silently normalize a stored True into False.
finite_batch.golden_effect: Observedness, raw error value and actual definedness can be tested independently.

finite_batch.question: Freeze the exact DecodedLedger.to_dict shape and container types, including module_edges and any derived values, plus FormatError code, offset and path field types and None rules. This prevents the independent tests from guessing an implementation surface after code exists.
finite_batch.golden_effect: Positive decoding and invalid data outcomes have source-independent expected values.

bounded_plan.count_rule: The final expanded malformed-byte vector count, exact fixture IDs, callback calls and getters will be pinned separately before implementation. The draft 512-case ceiling is provisional, not generation authorization or an actual count.
bounded_plan.coverage_limit: Representative mutations cover every reserved region, with boundary/interior controls and independent static review. Do not claim an individual test for every reserved byte without an explicit expanded count.

claim_split.pure_format: Byte layout, closed data domains, malformed rejection, cached immutable data and original check-exception identity.
claim_split.genuine_producer_pending: Live first-fact assignment, diagnostic borrow/commit/release, same-owner issued bytes and strict legacy opaque-identity parity require actual producer source and future scope.
claim_split.full_cap_shape: Generated metadata and section extents prove representation boundaries only, not a real native history, full roster, measured RSS or clock fit.
